profile.headline: Sr Firmware/ Hardware / Systems Engineer - Consultant
profile.summary:
Firmware-focused senior engineer with more than four decades of software/firmware, hardware and system design experience. Current work centers on embedded firmware, product support, PC-based engineering tools and simulators, protocols, system architecture, troubleshooting, and manufacturing support. Broad hardware background provides strong system-level understanding from circuitry through embedded software. Earlier-career experience includes extensive ASIC and FPGA design, with FPGA implementations used for pre-silicon validation of ASIC designs and system architectures. Known for solving difficult cross-disciplinary problems and moving practical designs from concept through production. Team leader and motivator with a track record of first-pass success and delivering products on aggressive time-to-market schedules.
  
Issued patents: 66
Multiple coat reduction preojects
Technical lead / hands-on manager.
Software   / firmware development: 40+ yrs
  
TECHNICAL EXPERTISE
  
Firmware / Embedded SW
C, C++, assembly, RTOS, bare metal, HAL/driver libraries,   APIs, bootloaders, device control, test automation

Processors /   Platforms
ARM,   Nordic nRF51, STM32, Renesas, PSoC, PIC, Microchip, TI, Freescale/NXP, Atmel

Interfaces /   Protocols
UART,   SPI, I2C, I2S, USB, DMA, ADC/DAC, PWM, GPIO, RS-232/422/423/485, MII, DMX/RDM

Wireless / Security
802.15.4/Zigbee,   Bluetooth LE, power-line communications, DES, AES, SHA, PKI

Earlier ASIC / FPGA
Extensive prior experience with Verilog, Synopsys tool   chain, Xilinx, Altera, Lattice, RTL, synthesis, scan/ATPG, BIST, ASIC and   FPGA design, FPGA-based pre-silicon validation of ASIC designs, and system   prototyping

Hardware Design / Lab
Extensive digital/embedded hardware design; Altium   schematic/PCB, 3D modeling/printing, oscilloscopes, logic/protocol analyzers,   J-Link

Development Tools
IAR, Keil, Eclipse/GNU/GCC, CodeWarrior, Code Composer,   MPLAB, Visual Studio, C#, VS Code, Git/GitHub

positions.title: Sr Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop embedded production firmware and PC-based engineering tools while supporting new product development, manufacturing, cost-of-quality investigations, and intellectual property for cooking products.
• Represent Roper software within the GE Appliances Louisville cooking-software team and support multiple products on manufacturing lines.
• Analyze factory and field issues, develop corrective algorithms and code, and communicate findings and recommendations to the broader software team.
• Introduced J-Link programming factory automation that supports simultaneous programming of multiple microcontrollers from different vendors.
• Develop C# PC support tools and product simulators used for engineering development, troubleshooting, and validation.
• Develop embedded software for interconnected bare-metal processors using agile development, sprint planning, test-driven development, and automated integration testing.
• Develop algorithms to improve cooking performance and serve as the local intellectual-property representative, including invention-disclosure training and engineering support.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Developed RTOS and bare-metal ARM firmware for payment and vending-equipment products.
  
• Developed application, DFU bootloader, and driver firmware for Nordic nRF51822 BLE SoCs and STM32 ARM microcontrollers.
• Implemented wired and wireless interfaces including 802.15.4/Zigbee, BLE, UART/RS-232, SPI, I2C, and power-line carrier communications.
• Refactored firmware for reuse across product platforms and between bare-metal and RTOS implementations.
• Designed/ redesigned hardware in Altium and developed 3D-modeled/printed components; resulting products reduced costs by more than $2M and opened new product and market opportunities.
• Created an Android BLE engineering tool and production-test hardware/software for new and existing products.
• Provided architecture guidance and proof-of-concept development for next-generation products.

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description:
Provided system architecture, protocol, hardware, FPGA, and firmware development services across a range of products, including selected smaller FPGA-related implementation, prototyping, and validation projects.
  
• Developed FreeRTOS and bare-metal firmware using ARM, Atmel, Freescale, Cypress, TI, and Microchip microcontrollers.
• Worked across Eclipse/GCC, CodeWarrior, PSoC Designer, MPLAB, Xilinx ISE, Lattice Diamond, Altera Quartus II, Altium Designer, and Visual Studio.
• Designed closed-loop systems for LED lighting, EMF generation, chemical alteration, particle counting, and a Wi-Fi-connected cooking appliance.

positions.title: CTO
positions.description:
Led development of a multifactor-authentication and real-time location system (RTLS) while remaining directly involved in architecture, protocols, hardware, software, and selected FPGA-based design validation work.
  
• Defined the initial system architecture, communications protocols, and functional specifications.
• Implemented a proprietary TDMA protocol over an IEEE 802.15.4 physical/transport foundation; related work is reflected in U.S. Patent 8,036,152.
• Built a technology facility and an 18-person engineering organization spanning software, hardware, RF, and mechanical disciplines.
• Directed engineering operations, schedules, technical reviews, facilities, infrastructure, and vendor selection while continuing hands-on development and problem solving.

positions.title: Engineering Consultant / President
positions.description:
Led a startup developing reconfigurable FPGA-based test equipment and providing electronics-industry consulting services.
  
• Translated customer and market requirements into product definitions, protocols, system architectures, hardware, and software implementations.
• Member of the Xilinx XPERTS Alliance.

positions.title: Chief Engineer, Digital Technology
positions.description:
Joined XM at startup as a technical cofounder and helped drive the satellite digital radio system, protocol, receiver architecture, security architecture, and VLSI/baseband development from concept to commercial deployment.

• Redesigned the protocol, security, receiver, system, and baseband-chipset architectures to improve flexibility, security, performance, and first-pass success, including work with elliptic-curve cryptography (ECC).
• Guided European technology vendors and led FPGA implementation of the receiver design, continuing the ASIC/FPGA development approach used since Motorola: FPGA implementations validated the ASIC and system design and enabled field testing and product development roughly 6–12 months before ASIC silicon was available.
• Proposed and implemented complex digital products spanning embedded hardware/software, Verilog HDL for baseband/DSP ASICs, and FPGA-based chipset monitoring and stimulus.

positions.title: ASIC Mgr / Senior Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Led digital and mixed-signal ASIC and FPGA development for wireless paging products, using FPGA implementations to validate ASIC designs before silicon while providing technical leadership to global design teams.
  
• Proposed and led an eight-engineer team implementing paging SoCs and peripheral communications devices.
• Worked directly in ASIC RTL design, clock distribution, BIST, scan insertion/ATPG, and layout, with parallel FPGA implementations used to validate ASIC functionality before tape-out and silicon availability.  
• Developed assembly and C test code for FPGA prototypes and final silicon; participated in technology, product, and tool-roadmap committees.

positions.title: Staff Electrical Engineer/ASIC Engineer
positions.description:
Led and developed wireless baseband, DSP, ASIC, FPGA, and product architectures based on ETSI/CT2 and DECT standards. ASIC and FPGA development were closely coupled, with FPGA implementations used extensively to validate ASIC designs before silicon was available; work included baseband transceiver design, scan/simulation, ADPCM CODEC integration, and CT2 and DECT base station/portable ASIC baseband-DSP architecture.
  
• Interpreted ETSI specifications, worked with marketing on product requirements, and developed portable, infrastructure, and configurable ASIC architectures.

company.name: Motorola Land Mobile Sector / Personal Communications Division

positions.title: Electrical Engineer / President
positions.description: Provided consulting services to startup corporations in need of quick solutions to existing designs. This included evaluating the customers' current application and designs, communicating to the customers senior management the architecture and design issues, and proposing alternative system solutions in all aspects of electronic product and system design. Customers were primarily in the Telecommunications and Biomedical fields.

positions.title: Embedded Firmware / Electrical Engineer
positions.description: Position required the design and development of highly integrated line cards providing up to 48 UART interfaces. Portable BER hardware and software development and RS485 to RS232 limited distance modems.
